He has this massive pegboard wall for all his tools, perfectly outlined with marker so you know exactly where everything goes. He ruined this gorgeous silk scarf my sister got me for my birthday last year. She got it from this little boutique in Paris when she went for her honeymoon. I've always wanted to go to Paris, just to see the Impressionist stuff at the Musée d'Orsay.
